name: button
title: Button
description: Primary action control. Daybreak v2: ember fill with ink text (4.8:1), mono 13px uppercase, 2px radius, no shadow. Secondary/outline use a hairline edge.

meta.behaviourReason: Presentational. Uses Radix Slot only for asChild.
meta.a11y: Focus-visible 2px outline (--ring, 2px offset). Disabled is pointer-events-none + opacity. Text on ember is always ink, never cream or white.
